v: Crowchild Trail is named after a real chief. Who was he?
David Crowchild, chief of the Tsuut'ina Nation from nineteen forty-six to nineteen fifty-three.
When city officials asked to use his name, he gave his blessing.
He said: may this be a symbol of cutting all barriers between all peoples, for all times to come.
